description: This file is a shell script related to testing Git's rerere (reuse recorded resolution) functionality. It contains setup scripts, a series of test cases, and functions to verify rerere behavior, such as conflict resolution, timestamp handling, garbage collection, and error cases.

methods.name: rerere_gc_custom_expiry_test
methods.description: A function to test garbage collection in rerere with custom expiry times, adjusting the age of rerere cache files and verifying that cache entries are preserved or removed based on configuration.

methods.name: concat_insert
methods.description: A helper function to concatenate content from predefined 'early' and 'late' files with variable sections for merge conflict scenarios.

methods.name: count_pre_post
methods.description: A function to count 'preimage' and 'postimage' files in the rerere cache directory to verify the number of recorded conflict resolutions.

methods.name: merge_conflict_resolve
methods.description: Simulates a merge conflict resolution by creating conflicting files with predefined content.
